title: Breaking Chains with Trees: Model-Parallel Deep Learning with $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ Time Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2606.21497v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern deep neural networks are trained using error backpropagation, which requires sequential forward and backward computations across network layers. As these networks become deeper, this introduces limitations, since layer-wise updates are strictly interdependent and cannot proceed in parallel. These constraints restrict training procedures to data-parallel schemes, thereby prohibiting model-parallel training. We propose TreeProp, an architecture-agnostic variational learning framework that organizes network layers into a tree-structured hierarchy. During training, TreeProp replaces sequential forward computations and backward gradient propagation with hierarchical computations. This allows intermediate representations and learning signals to be constructed in time complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ for a network of $N$ layers. translated_title: 打破链式束缚：以\(\mathcal{O}(\log N)\)时间复杂度的模型并行深度学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.21497v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：现代深度神经网络使用误差反向传播进行训练，这需要跨网络层的顺序前向和反向计算。随着网络变得更深，这引入了限制，因为逐层更新严格相互依赖，无法并行进行。这些约束将训练过程限制在数据并行方案中，从而禁止模型并行训练。我们提出了TreeProp，一种架构无关的变分学习框架，将网络层组织成树状层级结构。在训练期间，TreeProp用层级计算替代顺序前向计算和反向梯度传播。这使得中间表示和学习信号能够以\(\mathcal{O}(\log N)\)的时间复杂度构建，其中\(N\)为网络层数。据我们所知，TreeProp是首个用于深度神经网络的、实现模型并行训练的学习算法。
tldr: TreeProp通过将网络层组织成树状结构，实现了深度神经网络训练的模型并行，将计算复杂度从顺序依赖降至\(\mathcal{O}(\log N)\)，这是首个突破反向传播顺序限制的学习算法。
en_tdlr: TreeProp organizes network layers into a tree structure to enable model-parallel training of deep neural networks, reducing computational complexity to \(\mathcal{O}(\log N)\), marking the first learning algorithm to break the sequential backpropagation constraint.
